name: slider
title: Dual Range Slider
description: A price filter with a low and high handle on a single track; the chosen span between them is filled white. Dragging either handle moves the number shown above it and updates the range.
use: Shoppers or users need to choose a minimum and maximum, such as a price band.
avoid: It suits numeric ranges only, and the 12px grips are hard to grab on a touch screen.
a11y: Handles take a focus ring and arrow keys, but no aria-label tells the low grip from the high one. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Inside a dark rounded card, a short horizontal track of tiny grid squares holds two white vertical grips, with the segment between them solid white. Dollar values float above each grip, and the endpoints of the full range sit below.
behaves: Dragging either grip slides it along the track and the numbers above roll to the new values, while the filled band between the grips grows or shrinks. Releasing settles it in place.
customise: Pass value and onValueChange plus min, max and step; label and labelPosition place the number badges. Track colours and handle shapes are class overrides.
weight: light: Two handles on a native-style track plus a small number roll animation.
